meta.name: story-review
meta.description: 多视角对抗式审查。full/lean 模式在已部署 reviewer agents 时并行 spawn；缺失/异常 agents 或 spawn 失败时自动降级 solo，参考文件不可读时使用内置 rubric fallback。触发方式：/story-review、/审查、「审查一下」「帮我审一下」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把写好的故事交给多个不同视角同时挑错,拿到分层的修改意见
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果故事写完想被人从多个角度挑刺再改
copy.tagline_en: Get your draft challenged from several angles and receive layered revision notes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've finished a story and want it picked apart before revising

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 成为审查协调器:读你的小说正文与设定,找出结构、角色、文字、设定层面的问题,并给出可执行修改建议。报告开头会写明实际执行的模式、降级情况和所用 rubric。
howto.when: 当你说「/story-review」、「审查一下」等触发,或要求审某个章节时接管。默认 full 模式并行调用多个 reviewer agent;agent 缺失、异常或调用失败时自动降级为 solo。

say.text: /story-review full 审一下最近改的这几章
say.note: 并行跑四个审查视角,再综合成一份报告

say.text: 帮我审一下第 12 章,重点看设定一致性
say.note: 只审指定章节,不扩大到全书

say.text: /story-review lean 只跑架构和一致性检查

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude acts as a review coordinator: it reads your novel's text and settings, finds structure, character, prose and setting problems, and gives actionable fixes. The report opens with the mode actually run, any fallback, and the rubric used.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "/story-review" or "review this", or ask for a chapter review. Default is full mode, spawning several reviewer agents in parallel; if agents are missing, malformed or fail to spawn, it falls back to solo.

say_en.text: /story-review full — review the chapters I just edited
say_en.note: Runs the reviewer agents in parallel, then merges one report

say_en.text: Review chapter 12, focus on setting consistency
say_en.note: Reviews only the given chapter, not the whole book
Uses only the story-architect and consistency-checker agents
